intro.text: Prime Aqasix Snoxil, a ruler of Azir in an earlier age. During his reign the Alethi warlord Sadees the Sunmaker overran Azir and sacked Azimir. His finger was preserved as a relic.

items.text: When Dalinar Kholin sought to bring Azir into his coalition, Snoxil's finger was brought out as a reminder of the last time the Alethi came to Azir in force.
